question: GQ-001
subject: unverifiable treated as wrong, for the third time today
symptom: during a rebuild the gate blocked a push on external_corpus.books/passages/words — three numbers that were CORRECT and merely unreadable, because the rebuild held a lock on the corpus database
why_it_matters: a rebuild takes ~40 minutes; a gate that cannot pass for 40 minutes of every ingest cycle is a gate that gets bypassed
the_script_already_knew: it labels these status 'unverifiable' as against a number read and disagreed — my gating filter simply ignored status

the_recurring_shape.first: mktemp failed -> empty logfile -> skip branch unreachable -> exit 9 on a correct corpus
the_recurring_shape.second: unreadable log database -> counts empty -> nothing to do, exit 0
the_recurring_shape.third: locked corpus database -> derivation unavailable -> gated a push on correct numbers
the_recurring_shape.common_root: an input that could not be READ being scored as a fact about the thing measured

the_fix: unverifiable and source_missing findings are reported, never gated; they are also NEVER counted as verified

verified_both_directions.a_falsified_snapshot_number: exit 3 — still catches it, even with the corpus db locked
